scientific_claim: Under the frozen WBG-2 raw-byte stream and recurrence/consistency selector, bounded four-byte motif discovery failed to recover the hidden predictive motif set and produced no causal held-out prediction or event-reduction benefit. The result is a valid negative against this specific selector/design, not against adaptive granularity in general.
next_question: Which recurrent non-target four-byte windows outranked the hidden predictive motifs under the frozen occurrence-times-consistency score, and is the failure attributable to score confounding, stream construction, or insufficient motif-identifiability evidence?
scope: bounded synthetic raw-byte motif discovery; no open-domain language claim
